submission.justification: D2 has the highest light yield but fails thermal cycling (30% failed against a 5% limit). Modules can't be accessed after the cryostat is filled, so D2 is excluded. D3 has the next-highest yield and passes thermal cycling at 2% failed. 30% coverage is the maximum allowed and the feedthroughs support it. D3 at 30% simulates to 36.5 PE/MeV. I did not simulate D1 at 30%. The 2025 summary gave D1 18 PE/MeV at 20% coverage against 27 for D3, so I expect D1 to be lower.

requirements.evidence: D3 at 30% simulates to 36.5 PE/MeV. This is the best among designs that pass robustness. D2 is higher but is excluded. D1 was not simulated at 30%, and the 2025 data at 20% put it below D3.
D3 had 2% failures after 20 cycles. D2 had 30% and D1 had 0.5%.
30%, and the meeting notes confirm enough feedthroughs for up to 30%.
